text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock A and Stock D repeatedly after gains; before selling more, I should consider each holding’s role and prospects rather than treat a gain as a signal to exit.","Buying Stock C and Stock E used cash, but their short-term moves do not by themselves show whether the decision was sound; I should judge trades against my plan over a suitable horizon.","My account value fluctuated despite periods with no trades, so I should assess the whole portfolio and keep decisions deliberate instead of reacting to short-term changes or my tendency to hold losers and sell winners."]}
